description: Medium article hooks for 2026. Focus: Authority, depth, thought leadership.

voice_requirements.structure: Similar to LinkedIn but longer (1500-3000 words)
voice_requirements.seo: Cross-post from blog with canonical URL

examples.hook: I [did surprising thing]. Here's what I learned.
examples.why_it_works: Authority through experience, promise of insight
Positions as insider knowledge, contrarian angle

examples.hook: I spent 6 months testing every AI agent on the market. Here's what I learned.
examples.why_it_works: Authority through sustained effort (6 months), comprehensive scope (every agent), lessons promise

examples.hook: Why your AI outputs suck (and it's not the model's fault)
examples.why_it_works: Blunt assessment, reframes blame to user (not AI), promises structural fix

examples.hook: The difference between people making money with AI and everyone else
examples.why_it_works: Divides audience into doers vs talkers, promises to reveal the gap

examples.hook: I replaced my $8K/mo team with AI. Here's the honest breakdown.
examples.why_it_works: Dramatic cost claim, honesty framing (not hype), breakdown promise

examples.hook: The skills that made you money in 2024 won't matter in 2027
examples.why_it_works: Specific years create credibility, urgent but not alarmist, forward-looking

examples.hook: I analyzed 50 glamping sites. The profitable ones all made the same design choice.
examples.why_it_works: Large sample (50 sites), single differentiator promise, research authority, B2B audience trusts data

examples.hook: The glamping ROI nobody shares: $80K investment, $240K year-one revenue, 4.2-month payback
examples.why_it_works: Specific numbers stacked, short payback period creates urgency, 'nobody shares' = forbidden knowledge

examples.hook: Why most glamping businesses fail in year 1 (and the 3 mistakes that guarantee it)
examples.why_it_works: Fear of failure hooks attention, specific mistakes (3), B2B operators invest heavily and fear collapse

examples.hook: Hotel rooms vs glamping tents: A $600K vs $180K comparison with surprising results
examples.why_it_works: Dramatic cost difference, same industry comparison, 'surprising results' promises contrarian data

examples.hook: The hidden costs of glamping that manufacturers won't tell you about
examples.why_it_works: Forbidden knowledge framing, buyer trust signal, industry opacity critique, practical value

examples.hook: How glamping operators achieve 80%+ year-round occupancy while hotels struggle at 30%
examples.why_it_works: Specific occupancy rates, universal hospitality problem, analytical depth fits Medium's long-form style

examples.hook: What 200+ glamping tent installations taught me about the hospitality industry
examples.why_it_works: Massive authority (200+), industry insight promise, long-form depth, thought leadership positioning

examples.hook: The resorts charging $500/night for glamping all understand something you don't about tent design
examples.why_it_works: Premium pricing ($500/night), direct challenge ('you don't'), design focus, status aspiration

examples.hook: Empty land to $150K/year: The glamping business model that's replacing hotel expansion
examples.why_it_works: Before/after with specific revenue, industry trend positioning, replacement narrative creates urgency

examples.hook: Tax benefits of glamping investments that your accountant probably doesn't know about
examples.why_it_works: Financial angle appeals to investors, 'accountant doesn't know' = insider knowledge, practical value
